plain_statement: It is false that: The edge function F of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges, written as a list of two-digit codes ab for the edge a b). If a circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates with at most 15 gates computes F and its first gate computes OR(x_0, x_4), then either F has a circuit of at most 14 gates, or F with the inputs x_0 and x_4 fixed false (7 inputs) has a circuit of at most 11 gates from which, for each of the two ways of turning on exactly one of x_0, x_4, redirecting the reads of at most two wires to a constant-true wire gives a circuit for F with that choice
title: It is false that: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate OR(x_0, x_4) computes
